hardware: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S / 128 GB UMA
scope: diagnosis, not quality evaluation or a byte-identical engine comparison
checkpoint_source: gen/qwen35-4b, converted locally with llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py --outtype f16

quantization.mantle: Q4_K layer projections, Q6_K output head, FP32 input embeddings and small recurrent projections
quantization.llamacpp: --pure Q4_K, tied token embeddings/output head Q6_K, ssm_alpha/ssm_beta overrides F32
quantization.caveat: Same source checkpoint and closely matched policy, not byte-identical quantization; input embedding precision differs. No MTP/speculative decoding enabled.

cache_precision.f32_attempt: This llama-bench revision rejects f32 for -ctk/-ctv; unsupported output retained in llamacpp_qwen4b_f32_unsupported.txt.

method_caveats: Mantle historical unprofiled results versus new llama.cpp measurements, not interleaved trials; shared desktop and CPU workloads remain possible confounders.
llama-bench uses random input tokens, excludes tokenization/sampling and synchronizes each decode; Mantle uses GPU-resident greedy feedback. Not an answer-quality comparison.
llama.cpp mean of 3 runs versus Mantle median; raw sample data retained.
4K gap includes cache precision and different attention kernels; this experiment does not isolate each contribution.

gpu_profile.caveat: Diagnostic timestamps; sums of per-pass costs are not a frame latency measurement.
